optimizedDescription.value: Shared check registry evaluates transition/archive predicates and effects with one ABI, matcher, progress bus, and projection source.

optimizedContext.value:
# Transition Checks

## Rules
- Stable check IDs include `protocol.edge`, `workflow.requires`, `workflow.taskCompletion`, `deps.consistent`, `workspace.readOnly`, `impl.filesResolved`, `impl.linksInScope`, `approval.spec`, `approval.signoff`, `schema.nameMatch`, `archive.archivable`, `spec.overlap`, `hook.pre`, `hook.post`; never `archive.publication`. Every check declares short gerund `label`, `kind: predicate|effect`, `execute(ctx)`. Result: id/label/kind/outcome pass|fail|skip, failure code/message, optional details. `instruction:` hooks are not checks.
- ABI: `Check`; abstract application `WorkflowCheck` with pass/fail/skip; `create<Name>(deps)` receives only ports used by that check. Domain pure `run(facts)` optional, never production I/O path. No `PredicateSnapshots`, `needs`, `emptyPredicateSnapshots`, or `gatherPredicateSnapshots`. One module pair/check; class declares id/kind.
- `CheckExecutionContext`: change, schema, transition attempt or archive operation, baked spec/signoff approvals, `skipHookPhases`, `allowOverlap`, `allowOutOfScope`, optional pure DAG status, `onCheckProgress`, per-evaluation `passMemo`. `workflow.taskCompletion` memoizes `CountTasks` there. No durable check-specific facts.
- Registry alone owns applicability bindings: `from`, `to`, `along`; effects also `phase: before-persist|after-persist`, `onFailure: abort|collect`, skip selector identity. No applicability on check object or duplicate domain table. Runtime IDs remain plugin-safe strings despite built-in TS union.
- `along`: forward, backward, redesign (`to=designing`), recovery (`archiving→archivable`), any. Axis uses known `schema.workflow[]` order, splicing omitted `ready`, `implementing`, `verifying`, `done`, `archivable`, `archiving` by `AXIS_FALLBACK` relative order. Unknown states occupy no slot; omission never removes protocol state.
- Transition evaluation: classify; execute `protocol.edge` (`TransitionChange` fail-fast, `GetStatus` collect-all); execute every matching predicate; allowed iff none fail; execute matching effects by slot only after predicates; persist between before/after slots. Never rewrite requested target for approvals.
- Archive is operation binding, not fake edge; `approval.signoff` never binds archive. Publication preflight remains inside `ArchiveChange`.
- Predicate bindings: requires/tasks target requested step; deps/readOnly enter-ready + archive; impl checks forward exit-implementing + archive, never redesign; spec approval forward exit-ready; signoff exact `done→archivable`; archive includes schema-name, archivable-state, overlap and shared deps/readOnly/impl. Approval off→skip, valid→pass, missing→`APPROVAL_REQUIRED`.
- Effect defaults: transition `hook.pre` any except recovery and `hook.post` forward, both before-persist/abort; archive pre before-persist/abort, post after-persist/collect. Hook checks call `RunStepHooks`; use cases never branch by hook ID. `skipHookPhases` skips effects only and matches phase plus target/source/pre/post identity.
- Before-persist abort throws `HookFailedError` without persistence. After-persist collect records failure and continues. Same matcher selects predicates/effects.
- Failed `impl.filesResolved` / `impl.linksInScope` text: count + ≤3 labeled examples; full inventory only structured/dedicated listing. deps failures show extracted vs persisted per spec; overlap names changes/specs; readOnly names spec IDs/workspace. Only `impl.linksInScope` gets `isSkippable` + `--allow-out-of-scope`.
- Generic progress envelope for every executed check: `check-start {id,label}`, optional `check-progress`, `check-done {id,label,outcome,reason?}`. Hook runner progress maps into same bus. Status never streams; structured rows/blockers retain label/checkId. Canonical labels remain defined per built-in ID.
- Projections derive only from check results: protocol-legal `validTransitions`; predicate-allowed `availableTransitions`; `nextAction` plus review blockers. Implementing + tasks complete + verifying allowed→`/specd-verify`; missing approvals→approval command; backward retries visible but not default.
- Historic parked approval states preserve approval-required repair before protocol rejection of non-drain target. Production status/archive registry injects overlap detector; dependency-free default registry only isolated/non-production.

## Constraints
- No schema/task/platform result-array split; origin is check metadata.
- recovery is not backward. Dry-run predicates only. Schema YAML cannot list check IDs.
- Timing/failure/skip/applicability come from bindings, never check-ID switches.
- Approval commands record consent separately; `TransitionChange` never routes into pending approval states.
- New check/plugin must not require lifecycle use-case gather logic changes.
